system.description: The greater version of Magical Addict: you are completely unable to focus yourself enough to perform even the simplest blood magic if your drug of choice is not currently in your system. You may not use any Assamite Sorcery powers or rituals without the aid of your preferred chemical. Only characters with at least one basic Assamite Sorcery power may take this Flaw (non-Assamites who somehow receive tutelage in the Discipline may also take it). Roleplay your character's drug use — do not actually use drugs yourself.
